title: Split gateway.go into 4 files
description: Split the 5,129-line gateway.go into 4 logical files: gateway_core.go (~1,100 lines: server struct, Run/RunWithAuth, startHTTPServer, middleware, rate limiter), gateway_handlers.go (~3,140 lines: all HTTP handlers + gRPC + request types), gateway_helpers.go (~620 lines: validation constants, parsers, business rules, error types), gateway_stream.go (~420 lines: WebSocket, bus taps, streaming). Delete original gateway.go after split. Build after each step.

implementationPlan.description: Create gateway_helpers.go: Extract utility functions, validation helpers, request types, parsers, middleware. Includes: validTopicRegex, rate limiter types/funcs, submitJobRequest/policyMetaRequest/policyCheckRequest types + methods, buildJobMetadata, buildPolicyCheckRequest, CORS middleware, API key helpers, rate limit middleware, tenant middleware, all parsers, normalize functions, statusRecorder, memoryPolicyError, jobBackpressureError, enforceMemoryID, enforceJobBackpressure, etc.

Create gateway_stream.go: Extract WebSocket/streaming code — wsClient, wsEvent types, upgrader var, stopBusTaps, startBusTaps, enqueueBusPacket, enqueueWSEvent, handleWorkflowJobResult, splitWorkflowJobID, handleStream, handleJobStream.

Create gateway_handlers.go: Extract ALL HTTP handlers and gRPC methods — handleGetWorkers through GetJobStatus, plus request types (artifactPutRequest, remediateJobRequest, createWorkflowRequest, rerunRequest, configUpsertRequest, schemaRegisterRequest, lockRequest).
Rename gateway.go to gateway_core.go: What remains is server struct, Close, Run, RunWithAuth, startHTTPServer, instrumented. Clean up imports.
Build and test: Run go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway and go test ./core/controlplane/gateway/... -count=1 to verify.
